```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"For many Americans, health care costs are still too high, even for those with insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"One-quarter of Americans reported problems or an inability to pay medical bills in the past year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to end surprise billing and other practices that lead to out-of-control medical debt that place an unconscionable economic strain on American households.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will repeal the excise tax on high-cost health insurance and find revenue to offset it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats need to contain the long-term growth of health care costs, but should not risk passing on too much of the burden to workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep costs down by making premiums more affordable.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep costs down by reducing out-of-pocket expenses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep costs down by capping prescription drug costs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight against insurers trying to impose excessive premium increases.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight any attempts by Republicans in Congress to privatize, voucherize, or phase out Medicare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will oppose Republican plans to slash funding and block grant Medicaid and SNAP, which would harm millions of Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
